description: INETL, the national statistics institute of Timor-Leste, publishes the basic tables of the 2022 Population and Housing Census as an Excel workbook of 24 sheets, alongside a 204 page main report. Population and private household counts run down to municipality, administrative post and suco, split urban and rural. Housing sheets count people and occupied housing units by type, from conventional dwellings with or without all basic facilities to shelters, tents and shacks, by outer wall material, conventional dwelling occupancy, main source of drinking water and the time taken to get water, and toilet type, sharing and sewage disposal. The report defines basic facilities as piped water and a toilet inside the dwelling, and it notes that this first release covers housing type, walls and water and sanitation, while roof, floor, year of construction and lighting energy appear only in the questionnaire. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: no lighting, electricity or roof tables are in this release, and the REDATAM dashboard gave a 503 from the cloud. Simulation uses: suco-level households with municipal housing and water access for water supply planning and exposure studies. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids.
